GLLVG.tool: Level Ground: Threat, Break Away, Convert
GLLVG.window.title: Level Ground
GLLVG.settings.autoStrip.name: Strip new creatures and hazards
GLLVG.settings.autoStrip.hint: When a GM creates an NPC or hazard, subtract its level from AC, saves, Perception, skills, attacks and the DCs it sets, and apply the Specialists cap. The printed values are kept and Unstrip restores them.
GLLVG.settings.autoSummoned.name: Halve summoned creatures
GLLVG.settings.autoSummoned.hint: An NPC created with the summoned trait gets the Summoned role: half its Hit Points, rounded down.
GLLVG.settings.reach.name: Reach
GLLVG.settings.reach.hint: A skill or Perception check called with a task rank takes −2 for each rank the character is below it (untrained counts as trained). Never on Break Away.
GLLVG.settings.outmatched.name: Outmatched (replaces incapacitation)
GLLVG.settings.outmatched.hint: Remove PF2e's incapacitation degree step. A higher-level target gains +4 to +10 to its save, and its critical failure is a failure; against its DC, the DC rises and a critical success is a success.
GLLVG.settings.convertActionDCs.name: Convert Treat Wounds and Administer First Aid DCs
GLLVG.settings.convertActionDCs.hint: The printed DC of these two actions is Converted when the check is rolled: 15, 20, 30, 40 become 14, 16, 18, 20. Treat Wounds is left to Breath and Blood while that feature is on.
GLLVG.settings.battleForms.name: Battle forms
GLLVG.settings.battleForms.hint: When a battle form effect is applied to a character, its AC loses "+ your level" and its attack and skill modifiers lose 2 × rank − 1.
GLLVG.settings.itemDCs.name: Items that impose their own DC
GLLVG.settings.itemDCs.hint: A consumable or piece of equipment of level 1 or higher created on an actor loses its level from each inline DC in its description (not scrolls, wands, staves or anything carrying a spell).
GLLVG.settings.levelProf.name: Level as a proficiency bonus
GLLVG.settings.levelProf.hint: A feat or effect that adds your level as a proficiency bonus (Untrained Improvisation and others) gives +0 in place of the untrained −2.
GLLVG.settings.massiveDamage.name: No death from massive damage
GLLVG.settings.massiveDamage.hint: When PF2e reports massive damage on a PC, undo the defeat it marks and tell the GM: dying as normal, one value higher.
GLLVG.settings.tempo.name: Tempo prompts
GLLVG.settings.tempo.hint: After another creature's turn ends, whisper the GM a Tempo prompt for each Solo that still has it this round. One card per Solo per round, updated in place.
GLLVG.settings.unbowed.name: Unbowed tracking
GLLVG.settings.unbowed.hint: Conditions and effects put on a Solo during combat end at the end of the third turn it starts afterwards. The GM sees what ends when and can exempt an entry.
GLLVG.settings.threatStrip.name: Threat strip in the combat tracker
GLLVG.settings.threatStrip.hint: Show the running encounter's band and percentage at the top of the combat tracker (GM only), in place of PF2e's own XP line.
GLLVG.settings.assuranceWarnings.name: Assurance warnings
GLLVG.settings.assuranceWarnings.hint: Warn when Assurance is used to Break Away, against a higher-level creature's statistic, or against a DC set by a higher level.
GLLVG.role.dialogHint: Mook: one quarter of its Hit Points, rounded up. Solo: twice its Hit Points, with Tempo and Unbowed. Summoned: half its Hit Points, rounded down. Elite or weak is applied first.
GLLVG.roleText.mook: Level Ground role: Mook. One quarter of its Hit Points, rounded up; it counts its Mook value in the Threat worksheet.
GLLVG.roleText.solo: Level Ground role: Solo. Twice its Hit Points, with Tempo and Unbowed; it counts twice its Threat value.
GLLVG.roleText.summoned: Level Ground: a summoned creature has half its Hit Points, rounded down.
GLLVG.solo.tempo.name: Tempo
GLLVG.solo.tempo.text: Frequency once per round; Trigger Another creature's turn ends. Effect The Solo gains 1 action and uses it immediately. An attack made with this action takes no multiple attack penalty. The Solo loses Tempo only while it is unconscious, paralyzed, petrified, or stunned for a duration. Slowed, and stunned with a value, never remove or reduce this action, and using it doesn't reduce the Solo's stunned value. The frequency resets at the start of the Solo's turn.
GLLVG.solo.unbowed.name: Unbowed
GLLVG.solo.unbowed.text: Each effect imposed by an enemy that puts a condition or penalty on the Solo ends at the end of the third turn the Solo starts after the effect is imposed, unless the Solo critically failed its saving throw, or the check against its DC critically succeeded. Unbowed doesn't end persistent damage, an affliction, the grabbed or restrained condition, or any effect the Solo could end by using an action. Against an effect with the incapacitation trait, the Solo always gains the full +10 Outmatched bonus and treats a critical failure as a failure, whatever the effect's level.

GLLVG.stripText.note: Changes AC, DCs and modifiers. Leaves damage, attributes, typed bonuses and flat checks. A skill, Lore, Perception or Will still above 12 + half the level after Strip is a specialist's and is lowered to that line, with any conditional value in the parentheses after it. Read it through before use.

GLLVG.setup.manualNote: Still by hand: simple DCs in PF2e's check prompt, Trick Magic Item's DC, and the Recall Knowledge DC of an elite or weak creature (PF2e reads its adjusted level). Convert them on the Convert tab.
GLLVG.setup.prompt.title: Level Ground setup
GLLVG.setup.prompt.pwol: Level Ground uses PF2e's Proficiency without Level variant with bonuses of −2, +2, +4, +6 and +8, and it is not set that way in this world.
